title: Locker Rental: timing basis for administrative closure of a past-due rental
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Locker Rental product line. It states when a past-due rental becomes eligible to be administratively closed. The specific grace period this rule reads for a given tier is fixed in the Locker Rental past-due status, late fee and reactivation terms; this document states only the timing rule itself.

## Rule
A past-due rental may be administratively closed only once the tier's grace period has fully elapsed since the moment the rental was marked past due, as shown by the system's own record of that rental. The elapsed time is counted as whole calendar days, with no rounding down of a partial day into a full day; the current moment must not be earlier than the moment the rental was marked past due plus the tier's grace period. A closure attempted before that moment has arrived does not satisfy this rule.

## Equivalent restatement
- Anchor: the moment, as recorded by the system, that the rental was marked past due.
- Duration: the grace period fixed for the rental's tier, counted in full calendar days.
- Comparison: the current moment must not fall earlier than the anchor plus the duration; a current moment exactly equal to anchor plus duration satisfies the rule, since "not earlier than" includes the boundary moment itself.

## Boundary case (hypothetical)
Suppose, purely as an illustration, a tier's grace period were fixed at 10 calendar days, and the rental was marked past due at the start of the 1st of a month. Full calendar days would elapse through the 11th of that month. A closure attempted at the start of the 10th would not satisfy the rule, since only 9 full calendar days would have elapsed and the grace period would not yet have fully run. A closure attempted at the start of the 11th would satisfy the rule, since exactly 10 full calendar days would have elapsed, matching the boundary itself, which the "not earlier than" comparison admits.
